If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him drink;
If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him drink; for by doing this you will heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord will repay you good things.
for by doing this you will heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord will repay you good things.
As cold water is welcome to a thirsty life, so is good news from a faraway land.
Eating much honey is not good, but one must honor glorious words.
Beat unapproved silver, and it will be cleansed, entirely pure;
Kill the impious from before a king, and his throne will prosper in righteousness.
Do not boast before a king, and do not station yourself in the places of rulers;

Do not boast before a king, and do not station yourself in the places of rulers; for it is better for you to be told, “Come up to me,” than for him to humble you before a ruler. Say what your eyes have seen.
for it is better for you to be told, “Come up to me,” than for him to humble you before a ruler. Say what your eyes have seen.
Do not rush quickly into battle, so that you do not regret it at the end. When your friend reproaches you,
withdraw backward; do not show contempt,
Silver given with deceit must be regarded like a potsherd; smooth lips cover a painful heart.
if the enemy entreats you with a loud voice, do not be persuaded, for seven evils are in his life.
Do not answer a fool in relation to his foolishness, so that you do not become like him;
but answer a fool according to his foolishness, so that he does not appear wise to himself.
Remove walking from legs, and a proverb from the mouth of fools.
Do not boast of things for tomorrow, for you do not know what the coming day will bear.
Do not abandon your friend or an ancestral friend, and do not enter your brother’s house when misfortune strikes you; a nearby friend is better than a brother dwelling far away.
Become wise, son, so that my heart may rejoice, and turn reproachful words away from yourself.
Take away his garment, for he has transgressed; one who ruins another’s property is insolent.
Let your neighbor praise you, and not your mouth, another, and not your lips.
Know thoroughly the lives of your flock, and set your heart upon your herds;
Open rebukes are better than concealed friendship. A friend’s wounds are more trustworthy than an enemy’s willing kisses.
An impious person flees when no one pursues, but a righteous person is confident like a lion.
Discipline a son, and he will love you and give adornment to your life; you must not heed a lawless nation.
One who gives to the poor will not be in need; but one who turns away his eye will be in great difficulty.
One who turns his ear aside so as not to hear the law has himself also abhorred his own prayer.
Insolence brings a man low, but the Lord supports the humble-minded with glory.
having feared and felt shame before people, they were tripped up; but one who trusts in the Lord will rejoice. Impiety gives a man a fall; but one who trusts in the Master will be saved.
Son, do not forget my ordinances; let your heart keep my words,

Son, do not forget my ordinances; let your heart keep my words, for they will add length of life, years of living, and peace to you. Do not let acts of mercy and faithfulness fail you. Fasten them around your neck, and you will find favor. And take thought for good things before the Lord and people.
Son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline or lose heart when corrected by Him,
Son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline or lose heart when corrected by Him, for the Lord disciplines the one He loves and scourges every son He receives.

Blessed is the person who found wisdom, the mortal who saw good sense, for trading in her is better than treasures of gold and silver. She is more valuable than costly stones; nothing evil will stand against her. She is readily known to all who approach her, and nothing precious is worthy of her.
Son, do not drift away; keep my counsel and thought,
You will not fear an approaching fright or the oncoming assaults of the ungodly, for the Lord will be upon all your ways and support your foot so that you are not shaken.
Do not refrain from doing good to someone in need whenever your hand has the means to help.
Do not say, ‘Go away and come back; tomorrow I will give,’ when you are able to do good, for you do not know what the coming day will bring forth.
Do not devise evils against your friend who lives nearby and trusts in you.
Do not let acts of mercy and faithfulness fail you. Fasten them around your neck, and you will find favor.
Do not seek enmity with anyone in vain, lest he do you some harm.
Do not acquire the reproaches of evil men or imitate their ways,
The Lord opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.
And take thought for good things before the Lord and people.
Trust God with your whole heart; do not exalt yourself in your own wisdom.

Trust God with your whole heart; do not exalt yourself on the strength of your wisdom. In all your ways acknowledge her, so that she may cut your ways straight, and your foot will certainly not stumble.
Do not be prudent in your own estimation; fear God and turn away from every evil.
Honor the Lord from your righteous labors, and offer Him firstfruits from your fruits of righteousness,
Fear my words, son, and receive them and repent. Thus says the man to those who trust in God, and I cease:
Do not hand a household servant over into a master’s hands, lest he curse you and you be destroyed.
Evil offspring judge themselves righteous, but have not washed away their discharge.
Do not add to His words, so that He may not reprove you and you become false.

Put a vain and false word far from me; give me neither wealth nor poverty; assign me what is needed and sufficient, so that I may not become full and false and say, ‘Who sees me?’ or become poor and steal and swear by the name of God.

A courageous woman—who will find her? Such a woman is more precious than costly stones. Her husband’s heart is confident in her; such a woman will not lack fine spoils. For she works good things for her husband throughout her life.
Give her from the fruits of her hands, and let her husband be praised in the gates.
Do not give women your wealth, or your mind and livelihood to belated counsel.
Do everything with counsel; drink wine with counsel. The powerful are hot-tempered, but let them not drink wine,
Give intoxicating drink to those in grief, and wine to drink to those in pain,
Open your mouth for God’s word, and judge everyone soundly.
Open your mouth for God’s word, and judge everyone soundly. Open your mouth and judge justly, and decide the case of the poor and weak.
Open your mouth and judge justly, and decide the case of the poor and weak.
Listen, children, to a father’s discipline; pay attention to gain discernment,
Listen, son, and receive my words, and your years of life will multiply, so that many ways of living may be yours,
Take hold of my discipline; do not release it, but keep it for yourself for your life.
Do not enter the ways of the ungodly or imitate the ways of the lawless.
Wherever they encamp, do not go there; turn away from them and pass by.
But the ways of the righteous shine like light; they go forward and illuminate until the day comes right. But the ways of the ungodly are dark; they do not know how they stumble.
for I give you a good gift; do not abandon my law.
Son, attend to my utterance; apply your ear to my words,
so that your springs do not fail you; keep them in your heart,
With every guard keep your heart, for from these come life’s outlets.
Remove a crooked mouth from yourself and thrust unjust lips far away from you.
Let your eyes look straight, and let your eyelids incline toward righteous things.

Let your eyes look straight, and let your eyelids incline toward righteous things. Make straight tracks for your feet and direct your ways aright. Do not turn to the right or the left; turn your foot away from an evil way.
Make straight tracks for your feet and direct your ways rightly.
Do not turn to the right or the left; turn your foot away from an evil way.
who used to speak to me and teach me: Let our word take hold in your heart;
keep commandments; do not forget or disregard an utterance of my mouth,
and do not abandon her, and she will hold fast to you; love her, and she will keep you.
Fortify her, and she will exalt you; honor her so that she may embrace you,
Son, attend to my wisdom, and incline your ear to my words,
Drink waters from your vessels and from your spring wells.
Do not let waters overflow for you from your spring; but let your waters travel into your own squares.
Let them belong to you alone, and let no outsider share with you.
Let your fountain of water be your own, and share joy with the wife of your youth.

Let your fountain of water be your own, and share joy with the wife of your youth. Let a deer of affection and a colt of your graces keep company with you. Let your own woman lead you and be with you at every time, for as you move in the company of her affection, you will be one among many.

Let a deer of affection and a colt of your graces keep company with you. Let your own woman lead you and be with you at every time, for as you move in the company of her affection, you will be one among many.
Do not be much involved with another woman, nor be held in the arms of one who is not your own.
Do not attend to a base woman, for honey drips from a prostitute’s lips; for a time she oils your throat.
Now therefore, son, listen to me, and do not make my words ineffective.
Put your way far from her; do not approach the doors of her houses,
Son, guard your father’s laws, and do not reject your mother’s ordinances.
Fasten them always upon your soul, and collar them around your neck.
because the commandment of law is a lamp and a light, and correction and discipline are life’s way,
Do not let desire for beauty overcome you; do not be hunted by your own eyes, nor seized by her eyelids.
Son, do what I command you and save yourself—for through your friend you have come into evil men’s hands. Go without growing slack, and press the friend for whom you acted as guarantor.
Give no sleep to your eyes, nor doze with your eyelids,
so that you may save yourself like a gazelle from snares and like a bird from a trap.
Go to the ant, sluggard; see its ways and emulate them, and become wiser than it.

How long do you lie down, sluggard? When will you rise from sleep? You sleep a little, sit a little, doze a little, and clasp your chest with your hands a little; then poverty arrives beside you like an evil traveler, and want like a good runner.
Son, guard my words, and hide my commandments with yourself.

Son, guard my words, and hide my commandments with yourself. Son, honor the Lord and you will be strong; apart from Him, fear no other. Guard my commandments and you will live, and my words like the pupils of eyes. Put them around your fingers; inscribe them on the broad surface of your heart.
Guard my commandments and you will live, and my words like the pupils of eyes.
Now therefore, son, listen to me, and attend to my mouth’s sayings.
Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways.
Put them around your fingers; inscribe them on the broad surface of your heart.
Say that wisdom is your sister, and acquire understanding as your familiar companion,
Take discipline rather than silver, and knowledge above tested gold; choose discernment rather than pure gold.
I love those who love me, and those who seek me will find me.
Now, therefore, son, listen to me.
Happy is the man who will listen to me, and the person who will keep my ways, staying awake at my doors day by day, guarding the posts of my entrances.
Understand resourcefulness, you innocent ones; and you uneducated, put your heart into it.
Listen to me, for I will speak noble things, and bring forth upright things from my lips.

Wisdom built herself a house, and set seven pillars beneath it. She slaughtered her own sacrificial animals, mixed her own wine in a mixing-bowl, and prepared her own table. She sent her own servants, summoning with a lofty proclamation to the mixing-bowl, saying: “Whoever is foolish, let him turn aside to me!” And to those lacking understanding she said: “Come, eat of my loaves, and drink wine that I mixed for you. Leave foolishness, and you will live; seek understanding, so that you may live, and set insight right in knowledge.”
But leap away; do not linger in the place, and do not fix your eye upon her.
But keep away from foreign water, and do not drink from a foreign spring,
“Come, eat of my loaves, and drink wine that I mixed for you.
Leave foolishness, and you will live; seek understanding, so that you may live, and set insight right in knowledge.”
Do not reprove evil people, so that they may not hate you; reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Give a wise person a starting point, and he will be wiser; inform a righteous person, and he will receive still more.

Blessed is the man who did not walk in the counsel of the ungodly, and did not stand in the way of sinners, and did not sit in the seat of pestilent people; but his will is in the Lord’s law, and on His law he will meditate day and night.

but his will is in the Lord’s law, and on His law he will meditate day and night. He will be like the tree planted beside the outlets of waters, which will give its fruit in its season, and whose leaf will not fall off; and everything he does will be prospered.
Let this be written for another generation, and the people being created will praise the Lord,
Of David. Bless the Lord, my soul, and all that is within me, His holy name.

He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our lawless deeds, for according to heaven’s height above the earth, the Lord strengthened His mercy toward those who fear Him. As far as the east is distant from the west, He removed our lawless deeds from us.
As a father has compassion on children, the Lord had compassion on those who fear Him,
for He knew our formation. Remember that we are dust.
But the Lord’s mercy is from eternity to eternity toward those who fear Him, and His righteousness toward children’s children, to those who keep His covenant and remember His commandments to do them.
Bless the Lord, my soul, and do not forget all His repayments:
Bless the Lord, all His angels, mighty in strength, doing His word, so as to hear the voice of His words.
Bless the Lord, all His powers, His ministers who do His will.
Bless the Lord, all His works, in every place of His dominion. Bless the Lord, my soul.
The Lord is compassionate and merciful, patient and abundant in mercy.
Let the Lord’s glory be for ever; the Lord will rejoice in His works.
May sinners vanish from the earth, and lawless people, so that they no longer exist. Bless the Lord, my soul.
Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord and call upon His name; announce His works among the nations.
Do not touch My anointed ones, and do not act wickedly against My prophets.
Sing to Him and make music to Him; recount all His wonders.
Be praised in His holy name; let the heart of those seeking the Lord rejoice.
Seek the Lord and be strengthened; seek His face continually.
Remember His wonders that He did, His portents and the judgments of His mouth,
Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; His mercy is for ever.
Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; His mercy is for ever.
Let them acknowledge to the Lord His mercies and His wonders to the sons of men,
Let those redeemed by the Lord say so, those He redeemed from the enemy’s hand.
Let them acknowledge to the Lord His mercies and His wonders to the sons of men,
and let them sacrifice a sacrifice of praise and proclaim His works in exultation.
Let them acknowledge to the Lord His mercies and His wonders to the sons of men,
let them exalt Him in an assembly of the people and praise Him where the elders sit.
Let them acknowledge to the Lord His mercies and His wonders to the sons of men,
Awake, psaltery and lyre! I will awake at dawn.
Of David. A psalm. The Lord said to my lord: Sit at My right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
Each spoke empty things to his neighbor; deceitful lips spoke with a heart and a heart. May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips and a boastful tongue—
He made remembrance of His wonders; the Lord is merciful and compassionate. He gave food to those who fear Him; He will remember His covenant forever.
Hallelujah! Praise the Lord, servants; praise the name of the Lord.

Who is like the Lord our God, who dwells in high places, and looks upon lowly things in heaven and on earth? He raises the poor from the ground and lifts the needy from the dung heap, to seat him with rulers, with the rulers of His people.
lest the nations say, “Where is their God?”
But our God is in heaven above; in the heavens and on the earth He has done everything He wished.
Return, my soul, to your rest, for the Lord has benefited you,
What shall I repay to the Lord for everything He has repaid to me? I will take the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord.
Hallelujah. Praise the Lord, all nations; laud Him, all peoples,
Praise the Lord, all nations; laud Him, all peoples,
Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy is for ever.
Open for me the gates of righteousness; entering through them, I will give thanks to the Lord.
Let the house of Israel now say that He is good, that His mercy is for ever.
This is the day the Lord has made; let us exult and be glad in it.
The Lord is God, and He has shone upon us. Arrange a festival among the thickly covering boughs, up to the horns of the altar.
Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy is for ever.
Let the house of Aaron now say that He is good, that His mercy is for ever.
Let all those who fear the Lord now say that He is good, that His mercy is for ever.
In my heart I hid Your sayings, so that I might not sin against You.
Turn away from me, evildoers, and I will search out my God’s commandments.
My eyes were awake before dawn to meditate on Your sayings.
And I spoke of Your testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed.
I considered Your ways and turned my feet toward Your testimonies. I was prepared and was not troubled to keep Your commandments.
The law of Your mouth is better for me than thousands of gold and silver.
How I loved Your law, Lord! It is my meditation all day.
Do not give your foot over to shaking, and may your Keeper not slumber.
Ask, then, for the things that bring Jerusalem peace, and prosperity for those who love you.
Those sowing in tears will reap with exultation. Going, they went and wept, carrying their seeds; but coming, they will arrive with exultation, carrying their sheaves.
Unless the Lord builds a house, those building it have labored in vain. Unless the Lord guards a city, the watchman has kept awake in vain.
Your wife is like a flourishing vine in the sides of your house; your sons are like newly planted olive trees around your table.
If You closely watch lawless deeds, Lord, Lord, who will withstand? For with You is atonement.
Because of Your law I waited for You, Lord; my soul waited for Your word. My soul hoped in the Lord from the morning watch until night; from the morning watch let Israel hope in the Lord.
For with the Lord is mercy, and with Him is abundant redemption,
Lord, my heart was not exalted, nor were my eyes raised high; I did not walk among great things nor among wonders beyond me.
If I was not humble-minded, but exalted my soul— like the weaned child upon its mother, like repayment upon my soul.
Let Israel hope in the Lord, from now and for ever.
Look, what is good or what is delightful except for brothers to dwell together?
A song of the ascents. Behold, bless the Lord, all slaves of the Lord, who stand in the Lord’s house, in the courts of the house of our God.
By night lift your hands toward the holy places and bless the Lord.
Hallelujah! Praise the Lord’s name; praise the Lord, slaves,
House of Israel, bless the Lord; house of Aaron, bless the Lord.
House of Levi, bless the Lord; you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good; make music to His name, for it is beautiful.
Hallelujah! Give thanks to the Lord, for He is kind; for His mercy is for ever.
Give thanks to the God of gods; for His mercy is for ever.
Give thanks to the God of heaven; for His mercy is for ever. Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for His mercy is for ever.
Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for His mercy is for ever.
And let them sing in the Lord’s ways, for great is the Lord’s glory.
For the Lord is high and watches the lowly, and the lofty He knows from afar.
Lord, You tested me and knew me. You knew my sitting and my rising; You understood my reasonings from afar. You traced my path and my measuring cord, and You foresaw all my ways.

One who walks blamelessly and works righteousness, speaking truth in his heart, who did not act deceitfully with his tongue, nor do evil to his neighbor, and did not take up reproach against those nearest him. One who acts wickedly is held in contempt before him, but he honors those who fear the Lord; one who swears to his neighbor and does not set it aside.
Let my prayer be directed as incense before You, the lifting of my hands as an evening sacrifice.

Set a guard, Lord, for my mouth and a restraining door around my lips. Do not turn my heart toward words of wickedness, to offer excuses for sins with people who practice lawlessness, and I will certainly not join with their chosen ones.
A righteous man will discipline me in mercy and correct me, but let a sinner’s oil not enrich my head, for still my prayer is amid their good pleasures.
The Lord is near to all who call on Him, to all who call on Him in truth. He will fulfill the will of those who fear Him; He will hear their plea and save them.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, my soul.
Do not trust in rulers and in sons of men who have no salvation.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, for a psalm is good; may praise be pleasing to our God.
Begin singing to the Lord with thanksgiving; make music to our God with a lyre,
who gives the cattle their food and to the young ravens who call upon Him.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Commend the Lord, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Let them praise the Lord’s name, for His name alone was exalted; His praise is over earth and heaven.
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His powers.
Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all the stars and the light.
Praise Him, heavens of heavens, and the water above the heavens.
Let them praise the Lord’s name, for He spoke, and they came to be; He commanded, and they were created.
Praise the Lord from the earth, dragons and all deeps,
Hallelujah. Sing a new song to the Lord, His praise in the assembly of holy ones.
Let Israel rejoice in the One who made it, and let Zion’s children exult in their King.
Let them praise His name in a chorus; with tambourine and psaltery let them make music to Him.
Holy ones will boast in glory and rejoice upon their beds.
Exaltations of God in their throat, and two-edged swords in their hands,
to execute vengeance among the nations, reproofs among the peoples,
to bind their kings in fetters and their glorious ones in iron handcuffs,
to execute upon them a written judgment. This is glory for all His holy ones.
The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You are the One who restores my inheritance to me.
I kept seeing the Lord before me continually, because He is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.
Hallelujah. Praise God among His holy ones; praise Him in the firmament of His power.
Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.
Praise Him with the sound of a trumpet; praise Him with psaltery and lyre.
Praise Him with tambourine and chorus; praise Him with strings and instrument.
Praise Him with well-sounding cymbals; praise Him with cymbals of a shout.
Let every breath praise the Lord. Hallelujah.
The Lord lives! Blessed be my God! Let the God of my salvation be exalted,
Their sound went out into all the earth, and their utterances to the limits of the inhabited world. In the sun He set His dwelling.

The Lord’s law is blameless, turning souls; the Lord’s testimony is trustworthy, making infants wise. The Lord’s ordinances are upright, rejoicing the heart; the Lord’s commandment shines afar, giving light to the eyes.
And now, kings, understand; be instructed, all who judge the earth.
Serve the Lord with fear, and exult in Him with trembling.
Take hold of instruction, lest the Lord become angry and you perish from a righteous way. When His fury burns quickly, blessed are all who have trusted in Him.
Ask of Me, and I will give you nations as your inheritance, and the ends of the earth as your possession.
You who fear the Lord, praise Him! All Jacob’s seed, glorify Him! Let all Israel’s seed fear Him,
All the limits of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the families of the nations will bow down before You, because kingship belongs to the Lord, and He is master of the nations.

The Lord shepherds me, and nothing will fail me. He made me dwell in a place of green growth; He nourished me beside water of rest. He turned my soul back; He guided me upon paths of righteousness for His name’s sake. For even if I walk in the midst of death’s shadow, I will fear no evils, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff comforted me.
You prepared a table before me opposite those who afflict me; You enriched my head with oil, and Your cup is intoxicating—how excellent!

Who will ascend the Lord’s mountain, and who will stand in His holy place? One innocent in hands and pure in heart, who did not take up his soul for emptiness and did not swear deceitfully to his neighbor.
Your rulers—lift up gates! And be raised, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
Your rulers—lift up gates! And be raised, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
He will guide the meek in judgment; He will teach the meek His ways.
The Lord is my illumination and my Savior; whom will I fear? The Lord is the protector of my life; of whom will I be afraid?
Wait for the Lord; act courageously, and let your heart be strong, and wait for the Lord.
My heart said to You, “My face sought You.” Your face, Lord, I will seek.
A psalm of David, for the departure of the tent. Bring to the Lord, sons of God; bring to the Lord young rams; bring to the Lord glory and honor.
Bring to the Lord glory for His name; bow down to the Lord in His holy courtyard.
Sing praise to the Lord, His holy ones, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness,
Love the Lord, all His holy ones, because the Lord seeks truths and repays those who act with abundant arrogance.
Act courageously, and let your heart be strong, all who hope in the Lord.
Blessed are those whose lawless deeds are forgiven and whose sins are covered. Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will certainly not reckon, and in whose mouth there is no deceit.
Rejoice in the Lord and exult, righteous ones; boast, all upright in heart.
I made my sin known, and I did not cover my lawlessness. I said, “I will confess my lawlessness against myself to the Lord,” and You forgave the impiety of my sin. Diapsalma.
Do not become like a horse and mule that have no understanding; with bridle and muzzle tighten their jaws— those that do not approach you.
Of David. Exult in the Lord, righteous ones; praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre; make music to Him with a ten-stringed psaltery.
Sing Him a new song; make music well with a shout of triumph.
Let all the earth fear the Lord; let all who inhabit the world be shaken before Him.
Fear the Lord, His holy ones, for there is no deficiency for those who fear Him.
Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
Stop your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn aside from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, and He will rescue them from them all.
My soul will be praised in the Lord; let the meek hear and rejoice.
Magnify the Lord with me; let us exalt His name together.
Taste and see that the Lord is kind; blessed is the man who hopes in Him.
Taste and see that the Lord is kind; blessed is the man who hopes in Him.
But when they troubled me, I put on sackcloth and humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer will return to my bosom.
May those who desire my righteousness exult and rejoice; let them always say, “May the Lord be magnified”— those who desire His servant’s peace.
Of David. Do not be provoked to envy by those doing evil, nor envy those committing lawlessness.
Better is a little for the righteous than the great wealth of sinners.
I was young and indeed have grown old, and I have not seen a righteous person abandoned or his offspring seeking loaves.
Turn aside from evil and do good, and dwell for age upon age.
Hope in the Lord and show kindness; settle in the land, and you will be pastured on its wealth.
Wait for the Lord and keep His way; He will exalt you to inherit the land; you will see when sinners are destroyed.
Guard innocence and look upon uprightness, for a peaceful person has a remnant.
Reveal your way to the Lord; hope in Him, and He will act.
Submit to the Lord and beseech Him; do not be provoked to envy by one prospering in his way, by a person committing lawless deeds.
Cease from anger and abandon wrath; do not be provoked to envy so as to act wickedly.
Cease from anger and abandon wrath; do not be provoked to envy so as to act wickedly.
Indeed a person passes through as an image; yet they are troubled in vain. He stores treasure and does not know for whom he will gather it.

I proclaimed good news of righteousness in a great assembly; look, I will certainly not restrain my lips; Lord, You know. I did not hide Your righteousness in my heart; I spoke of Your truth and Your salvation. I did not hide Your mercy and Your truth from a great congregation.
Be angry, and do not sin; speak in your hearts, and upon your beds be pierced with remorse. Diapsalma.
Be angry, and do not sin; speak in your hearts, and upon your beds be pierced with remorse. Diapsalma.
Offer a sacrifice of righteousness, and hope in the Lord.
Blessed is the one who understands the poor and needy; in an evil day the Lord will rescue him.
For Your sake we are put to death all day long; we were reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear, and forget your people and your father’s house,
and stretch forth, prosper and reign for the sake of truth and meekness and righteousness; your right hand will guide you wondrously.
“Cease your activity and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, exalted in the earth.”
Come, see the Lord’s works, the wonders He has set upon the earth.
All nations, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of exultation.
Make music to our God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
For God is King of all the earth; make music with understanding.
Encircle Zion and encompass her; recount in her towers,
set your hearts upon her strength and divide her citadels, so that you may tell another generation.
Do not fear when a person grows rich and when the glory of his house increases.
Do not fear when a person grows rich and when the glory of his house increases. For when he dies he will not take everything, nor will his glory descend with him.
Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all who inhabit the world,
Will I eat bulls’ flesh or drink goats’ blood? Sacrifice a sacrifice of praise to God and pay your vows to the Most High.
Sacrifice a sacrifice of praise to God and pay your vows to the Most High.

Understand these things, you who forget God, lest He seize you and there be no rescuer.
Gather His holy ones to Him, those who establish His covenant over sacrifices.
Create a clean heart in me, God, and renew an upright spirit in my inward parts.
Restore to me the exultation of Your salvation, and strengthen me with a governing spirit. I will teach the lawless Your ways, and the ungodly will turn back to You.
For if You had desired sacrifice, I would have given it; You will not delight in burnt offerings. A sacrifice to God is a broken spirit; a broken and humbled heart God will not despise.

Have mercy on me, God, according to Your great mercy, and according to the abundance of Your compassion blot out my lawless deed. Wash me more and more from my lawlessness, and cleanse me from my sin. For I know my lawlessness, and my sin is continually before me.
But I cried to God, and the Lord heard me. Evening, morning and noon I will recount; I will proclaim, and He will hear my voice.
Cast your care upon the Lord, and He will nourish you; He will never give the righteous a shaking.
Cast your care upon the Lord, and He will nourish you; He will never give the righteous a shaking.
By day I will fear, but I will hope in You. In God I will praise my words all day. In God I have hoped; I will not fear. What will flesh do to me?
Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and lyre! I will awake at dawn.
Stand away from me, all who work lawlessness, for the Lord heard the voice of my weeping.
Do not hope in injustice or long for plunder; if wealth flows, do not attach your heart.
Do not hope in injustice or long for plunder; if wealth flows, do not attach your heart.
Hope in Him, all the assembly of the people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our helper. Diapsalma.
My soul clung behind You; Your right hand supported me.
For the end. A song of a psalm. Of resurrection. Raise a shout to God, all the earth!
Come, hear, all who fear God, and I will recount all that He did for my soul.
Make music, then, to His name; give glory to His praise.
Come and see God’s works, fearsome in His counsels concerning the sons of men,
who rules the age by His power; His eyes look upon the nations. Let those provoking Him not exalt themselves within themselves. Diapsalma.
Bless our God, nations, and cause the sound of His praise to be heard,
That Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; make music to the Lord. Diapsalma.
Make music to God, who rides upon the heaven of heaven toward the east; behold, He will give with His voice a voice of power.
Give glory to God; His magnificence is over Israel, and His power in the clouds.
Let the righteous rejoice and exult before God; let them delight in gladness.
Sing to God; make music to His name. Make a road for Him who rides upon the west—Lord is His name— and exult before Him. They will be troubled before Him,
the Father of orphans and judge of widows, God in His holy place.
for zeal for Your house devoured me, and the reproaches of those reproaching You fell upon me.
Let the poor see and rejoice; seek God, and your soul will live,
Let the heavens and earth praise Him, the sea and everything creeping in them.
for on Your account I endured reproach; embarrassment covered my face.
Let his name be blessed through the ages; before the sun his name will endure. And all the tribes of the earth will be blessed in him; all nations will call him blessed.
For what is there for me in heaven? And what did I desire from You upon the earth? My heart and my flesh failed; the God of my heart and my portion is God forever.
I said to those acting lawlessly, “Do not act lawlessly,” and to those sinning, “Do not raise a horn;
do not lift your horn on high; do not speak injustice against God.”
Make vows and repay the Lord your God; all around Him will bring gifts
Of understanding. Of Asaph. Attend, my people, to my law; bend your ear to the words of my mouth.
and rained manna for them to eat, and gave them heaven’s bread. A human ate angels’ bread; He sent them food supplies to fullness.

And He chose David His servant, and took him up from the flocks of sheep; from behind the ewes giving birth He took him, to shepherd Jacob His people and Israel His inheritance. And he shepherded them in his heart’s innocence, and guided them with his hands’ understanding.
You who shepherd Israel, pay attention, You who guide Joseph like sheep; You who sit upon the cherubim, appear.
From the mouth of infants and nursing children You prepared praise, because of Your enemies, to bring down the enemy and the avenger.
There shall be no new god among you, nor shall you bow down to a foreign god.
For I am the Lord your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
Exult in God our helper; raise a shout to the God of Jacob.
Take up a psalm and sound the tambourine, a delightful psaltery together with a lyre.
Sound the trumpet at the new moon, on the conspicuous day of our feast.
Hear, My people, and I solemnly testify to you; Israel, if you listen to Me,
Judge for the fatherless and the poor; vindicate the lowly and the needy.
Judge for the fatherless and the poor; vindicate the lowly and the needy. Deliver the needy and the poor; rescue them from the hand of a sinner.”

For one day in Your courts is better than thousands; I chose to be cast aside in the house of God rather than dwell in the tents of sinners.
Sing praise to the Lord, who dwells in Zion; announce His deeds among the nations,
It is good to give thanks to the Lord and make music to Your name, Most High, to declare Your mercy in the morning and Your truth by night,
Understand now, you senseless among the people; and you fools, become wise at last.
A praise of a song, of David. Come, let us exult in the Lord; let us shout to God our Savior.
Let us come before His face with thanksgiving, and with psalms let us shout to Him.
Come, let us bow down and fall before Him, and let us weep before the Lord who made us.
For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture and the sheep of His hand. Today, if you hear His voice,

When the house was being built after the captivity; a song of David. Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth.
Say among the nations, “The Lord has become King!” For He also established the inhabited world, which will not be shaken. He will judge peoples with uprightness.
Let the heavens rejoice and the earth exult; let the sea be shaken, and all that fills it.
Sing to the Lord; bless His name. Proclaim the good news of His salvation day after day.
Sing to the Lord; bless His name. Proclaim the good news of His salvation day after day. Announce His glory among the nations, His wonders among all the peoples.
